subject: Music Production
title: Metro Boomin's Trap Empire
description: A quick, practical guide to Metro Boomin's Trap Empire.

hook.text: Leland Wayne started making beats at thirteen in St. Louis under the name Metro Boomin.

buildup.text: He moved to Atlanta and handed demo CDs to every rapper and manager he could find.

discovery.text: Metro's dark, atmospheric trap beats with heavy bass became the dominant hip-hop sound of the 2010s.

twist.text: He produced so many hits that 'Metro Boomin want some more' became a cultural catchphrase.

climax.text: Metro Boomin went from teen beat-maker to one of the most powerful figures in hip-hop.

punchline.text: A teenager with a laptop built trap music's empire.

quiz.question: How old was Metro Boomin when he started making beats?
